text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Correlation of the half-hourly anomalies of each GSP group's AGV and each zone's INDDEM (latest issue), 1 September 2025 to 20 September 2026. An anomaly is a series minus its mean at the same UK local half-hour, day type, and month. NGED's four groups are the top rows. The median over all cells is 0.42 for the raw series and 0.07 for the anomalies.'
text.tspan: Correlation of the half-hourly anomalies of each GSP group's AGV and each zone's INDDEM (latest issue), 1 September
2025 to 20 September 2026. An anomaly is a series minus its mean at the same UK local half-hour, day type, and
month. NGED's four groups are the top rows.
The median over all cells is 0.42 for the raw series and 0.07 for the anomalies.
